scientific_integrity: A complete elementary proof and a separately executable finite-field matrix checker accompany the statement. Foundational unsigned-incidence rank analysis from prior literature is acknowledged; computational samples are not presented as proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to degree-two graph face algebras and elements of the radical over finite fields; not a statement for higher-dimensional complexes, arbitrary monomial quotients, or nilpotent operators in general. Literature uniqueness has not been independently certified.
title: Support-refined Jordan census for finite-field graph face algebras
